$Comment: How the Headless Horseman flies in the saddle, phase 1 of his fight. Both mounted roles
(Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted and _Mounted_HM) name this file in
CombatAdditionalBehaviorComponent, the hook Template_Flying_Aggressive runs ahead of its own
combat moves on every tick he is fighting. The first instruction to set a body motion in a tick
wins, so a move set here overrides the template's, and where this file sets none (Engage) the
template's own chase flies him. On the hard ride the template keeps aiming and throwing his
bomb throughout.
He loops through these moves. Dive: he flies straight back at his target and down into his
role's MotionDesiredAltitudeCombat band (1 to 3 blocks up), until he is within DiveReach of
the player or DiveTimeLimit runs out. Engage: for EngageTime he fights low with the template's
own chase, where a sword reaches him. Then he breaks off, and the first of these that is due
wins: his first fountain lap (FirstLapAfter into the ride, always), a bomb pass (FirstLineAfter,
then every LineGap), a second or third lap (each LapGap after the last, an even chance against
a swing, never more than three), else a swing. Swing: for SwingTime he flies at full speed
between random points 7 to 9 blocks up on an oval round the graveyard's fountain, about 12
blocks out along the road and 9 across it, inside the road's barrier walls and above the
fountain's brazier. When a swing, a lap or a bomb pass ends (Break_End) he dives again, unless
a swoop is due (FirstSwoopAfter, then every SwoopGap) and his target is within SwoopRange.
Lap: eight points 7 blocks from the fountain's centre and 7 blocks up, round in order for
LapTime, about one or two laps. Swoop: the game's own Charge on a flier, shaped like its
Gobliterator's dash: half a second locked on to his target, then a one-second wind-up in which
his horse rears and screams and he glows (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Swoop_Glow) while a warning ring
(Feastmaster_Slam_Warning) lights on the ground where his target stands, then he charges at 20
blocks a second straight down through that spot, which a wind-up that never turns
(WindingUpRelativeTurnSpeed 0) keeps true, until the ground stops him, and fights low from
there. A player in his path takes the Burnt Praetorian's charge hit; his own creatures never
do (no NPCCollisionInteraction). If he cannot lock on within SwoopLockLimit he dives instead.
Bomb pass: he flies to a point 7 blocks above the road 12 blocks north or south of his target
(an even chance), and as he starts his pass to the far end a row of six warning rings
(Stalactite_Ground_Indicator) lights along the road through where his target stood, 4 blocks
apart, with a bomb (LineDrop) falling onto each that lands about 2 seconds later, as he thunders
over them. The pass lives here, not in the fight's script, because the row and his flight are
one move: the rings come from where he and his target are, so they stay in step with no
message between script and role, and the arena needs no extra tagged points.
Caught on something low (the fountain's brazier, a wall) while he dives, fights low, swings or
passes, for ClimbTime he flies at a point 10 blocks above the fountain's centre, up and away
from whatever held him, then carries on over it.
A timer starts only once in an NPC's life (TimerStart does nothing after that), so every move
here arms its timer with a TimerStart and a TimerRestart together; TimerRestart draws from the
RestartValueRange its first TimerStart gave. Every point is an Offset from where he spawned
(his leash point, read through the Leash sensor), and his spawn marker stands on the plaza's
north side, 7 blocks north of the fountain's centre (tools/arenas/Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.json
and _Hard.json). Move that marker and these offsets move with it, so change them together.
Offsets read X east, Y up from the floor, Z south. The timers, flags and position slots are this
file's own names. Raised beside his fight's script away from the graveyard, he loops the same
shapes around that spot.

DiveReach.Description: How close to his target a dive must bring him before he fights low.

DiveTimeLimit.Description: Seconds a dive may take before he fights low wherever he is.

DiveSpeed.Description: His speed on a dive, relative to his role's MotionFlyMaxHorizontalSpeed.

EngageTime.Description: Seconds he fights low over his target after each dive or swoop before he breaks off.

SwingTime.Description: Seconds each high swing lasts before he dives back.

SwingLegTime.Description: Seconds he flies toward one random point of the swing oval before picking another.

SwingSpeed.Description: His speed on a swing, relative to his role's MotionFlyMaxHorizontalSpeed.

LapTime.Description: Seconds a fountain lap lasts; at full speed one lap takes about 5.

LapSpeed.Description: His speed around the fountain, relative to his role's MotionFlyMaxHorizontalSpeed.

LapPointReach.Description: How close he must come to one lap point before he turns for the next.

FirstLapAfter.Description: Seconds after he starts fighting before a break-off becomes his first fountain lap, which always comes.

LapGap.Description: Seconds after one lap's turn before the next break-off rolls for another lap.

ExtraLapWeight.Description: The odds of the second and third laps: this weight against ExtraSwingWeight.

ExtraSwingWeight.Description: The odds that a second or third lap is a plain swing instead.

FirstSwoopAfter.Description: Seconds after he starts fighting before the end of a swing, lap or bomb pass may become his first swoop.

SwoopGap.Description: Seconds after one swoop starts before another may come.

SwoopRange.Description: How close his target must be when a swing, lap or bomb pass ends for him to swoop instead of diving.

SwoopLockLimit.Description: Seconds he may try to lock on before he gives up the swoop and dives.

FirstLineAfter.Description: Seconds after he starts fighting before a break-off may become his first bomb pass.

LineGap.Description: Seconds after one bomb pass starts before another may come.

LineLegLimit.Description: Seconds he may take to reach the start of a bomb pass, and again to fly it, before he moves on.

LineReach.Description: How close he must come to either end of a bomb pass to count as there.

LineSpeed.Description: His speed on a bomb pass, relative to his role's MotionFlyMaxHorizontalSpeed.

LineDrop.Description: The root interaction dropped onto each ring of a bomb pass. It should fall from high above, about 2 seconds.

ClimbTime.Description: Seconds he climbs toward the point above the fountain when something blocks him.

Instructions.$Comment: Once, the first time he fights: every timer this file waits on gets its first value and the range it restarts from.
Dive: straight back at his target and down into sword reach.
Blocked: rise for ClimbTime.
In reach, or the dive took too long: fight low for EngageTime.
DesiredAltitudeWeight 1 holds him to the role's MotionDesiredAltitudeCombat band as he closes.

Engage: no move of his own unless blocked, so the template's chase holds him low over his target. When EngageTime runs out he breaks off: the first that is due of his first lap, a bomb pass, a second or third lap roll, else a swing.
Blocked: rise for ClimbTime.
His first lap, always, at the first break-off once FirstLapAfter has passed.
A bomb pass, once LineGap has passed since the last (FirstLineAfter for the first) and he has a target to aim the row at. An even chance picks the end he starts from.
The roll for a second lap, at the first break-off once LapGap has passed since the first: an even chance of a lap, else a swing.
The roll for a third and last lap, LapGap after the second roll, the same even chance.
Otherwise a swing.
Swing: high and fast between random points on an oval round the fountain's centre (about 12 blocks out along the road, 9 across it, 7 to 9 blocks up), until SwingTime runs out (then Break_End).
Blocked: rise for ClimbTime.
Every SwingLegTime a fresh random point. DesiredAltitudeWeight 0 lets the point's own height win over his low combat band.
Break_End: a swing, a lap or a bomb pass is over and he is high. A swoop when one is due and his target is within SwoopRange, else a dive.

Swoop: the game's Charge on his flier. LockedOn 0.5 s at 10 degrees, then a 1 s wind-up that never turns (rearing, a horse's scream, glow, and a ring where his target stands), then 20 blocks a second down through that spot until the ground stops him; then he fights low. Its charge states follow the Charge in this list, as the game's own bosses lay theirs out.
Not locked on within SwoopLockLimit (no clear line to his target, or he could not turn onto it): he gives up and dives.

WindingUp: his horse rears and screams (its Alerted neigh with the game's horse scream, SFX_Horse_Death, over it), he glows, and a ring lights on the ground where his target stands, the spot he will charge through.
The charge is over (the ground or a wall stopped him, or he ran its length): he fights low from there.
His target went out of reach before he launched: dive instead.

Bomb pass, first leg: as it begins, the row's centre (7 above where his target stands) and its two ends 12 blocks north and south of it are stored; he flies to the end the coin chose, then starts the pass.
Blocked: rise for ClimbTime.
At the start, or the leg took too long: the pass begins.

Bomb pass, second leg: the row lights the moment it begins, six rings 4 blocks apart along the road through the stored centre, each with a LineDrop bomb falling onto it (marker and drop together, the game's falling-burst shape), and he flies over them to the far end, then dives.
Blocked: rise for ClimbTime.
At the far end, or the pass took too long: the break-off ends.

Lap_1 to Lap_8: round the fountain clockwise seen from above, north, east, south, west, 7 blocks from its centre and 7 up, until LapTime runs out (then Break_End). Each lap point is stored in the Lap_Point slot so the next instruction can tell when he reaches it.
